name: St John the Evangelist and St Ambrose
shortName: St John the Evangelist and St Ambrose

boundary.description: From Old Trafford station, S along Warwick Road South and King’s Road to the railway. Then S along the railway to Trafford – Manchester District boundary. E along that boundary to Upper Chorlton Road, Milton Grove, York Avenue, then E along Clarendon Road, Marlborough Avenue, E along Manley Road, Morville Road, Wilbraham Road, Wyverne Road and Egerton Road South to Withington Road. Then S along Withington Road, W along Mauldeth Road West to its junction with Nell Lane. Then SE along Nell Lane, Northern Grove, Barlow Moor Road, S along Palatine Road to the point where it meets River Mersey. NW along River Mersey and Trafford Manchester District Boundary to the point opposite Newport Road and by a straight line NW to the bend on Cromwell Road near Kings Road, and by Cromwell Road, Kings Road, Great Stone Road to and E along the railway to Old Trafford station.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St John the Evangelist and St Ambrose
internalBoundaries.description: From the junction of Mauldeth Road West and Nell Lane, W along Mauldeth Road West, Hardy Lane to the end of the road and by a beeline to River Mersey opposite Rifle Road (Leisure Center Betel UK – Manchester in Our Lady and St John parish).
